stem: A network performance study measures the download speed (Mbps) for a sample of 20 subscribers. The sample mean is 311.4 Mbps with a sample standard deviation of 109.4 Mbps. Assuming the data are approximately normally distributed, estimate the true population mean and provide a 95% confidence interval.

ground_truth.answer: Population mean ≈ 311.4 Mbps. 95% CI = [260.2, 362.6]. Point estimate: 311.4 Mbps.

common_failure_modes: Using z-critical value instead of t-critical for small samples
Not reporting the confidence interval alongside the point estimate
